about: The sharing register (RULINGS D-125; docs/specs/spec-card-sweep-2026-11-18.md §2, §4.1): every fx key that only hand entries of the library carry, and who else in the library prints it. cardfx-sharing.js says what each part means and checks it; test-cardfx.js is the gate. Definitions the rows answer to, where a key's effect is wider than what the bot reads (20 Nov 2026, the pilot's review; each listed card read in KRCG's text): lockTarget -- a minion enters combat with another and LOCKS it as part of that (Deep Song 'Enter combat with and lock', Iara 'enters combat with and locks the blocking minion', Malleable Visage 'this vampire and the blocking minion lock and enter combat'; not Coordinate Attacks, whose own Blood Brother locks). ceGrant -- a card lets its own minion strike: combat ends without a strike card ('can strike: combat ends'), in a scope (the first round, or the combat: Internal Recursion [pre]). rushGrant -- a card that sits on a minion (its host) and lets other minions enter combat with that host as a +1 STEALTH directed action, the card staying in play when they do (the value is that stealth). A card burned to make that rush is outside this key, a later key’s (pass 2 of the pilot’s review, F4): Hunting the Quarry (‘Vampires you control can burn this card to attempt to enter combat with the attached minion as a +1 stealth (D) action’) and Highway Haven: RV (‘Any werewolf may burn this equipment and enter combat with this minion as a +1 stealth (D) action’). The host-rush cards with no stealth (Cardinal Sin: Failure of Mission, Regent, Tracker's Mark, Unacceptable Appearance, Vendetta, Veneficorum Artum Sanguis, Warrant) are outside this key (the bot reads a rushGrant of 0 as no grant): a later key's; so is Rogue, whose +1 stealth is a vampire’s with Auspex only (‘Any vampire can enter combat with this vampire as a (D) action. Vampires with Auspex [aus] get +1 stealth on that action’): a condition this key does not carry. rushBy -- on a rushGrant card, who may rush through it when it is not any minion: the vampire chosen at placement (the contracts, Clandestine Contract), the acting vampire (Political Struggle), a clan, sect or group (Haqim's Law: Judgment, Shakar: the Hunt), any vampire (War Party), a vampire of another Methuselah (Blood Hunt). Haven Uncovered ('Minions can') is the default 'any'. hostOf -- on a rushGrant card, whose minion the host must be when it is not any minion: 'prey' (Priority Contract: 'a minion controlled by your prey'), 'other' (another Methuselah's: Political Struggle's text, and the directed placements of Blood Hunt, Clandestine Contract and War Party). A clan, age or title condition on the host (Dirty Contract, Haqim's Law: Judgment) is not hostOf. attach -- where a card goes that its own play puts on a minion of its player and that gives that minion +N strength or a maneuver each combat while it stays there: 'self' (the acting / this vampire), 'own' (a minion you control), 'ownVampire' (a vampire you control). Masters (Depravity), equipment, retainers, allies and a card that represents equipment (Zip Gun) are not attach. maneuverEach -- on such a card (attach's), the minion's optional maneuver each combat. The maneuver each combat of equipment (the guns, IR Goggles, Drum of Xipe Totec), retainers (Jackie Therman), allies, masters (Brujah Debate) and a card that becomes a vampire (Abomination) is not this key: the bearer readers' (C's). strengthBonus -- a card its play puts ON a minion (an action, a combat card or a master; not equipment, a retainer or an ally) that gives THAT minion +N strength while it stays there, on no condition (‘This vampire gets +1 strength’; Enrage [pre] ‘has +1 strength’ until the end of the turn; Mind of a Killer [dem] on any ready minion). Not this key (F4): a strength under a condition (The Black Beast: ‘In combat with a Camarilla vampire’; Ecstatic Agony’s +X), one the host gets by locking or burning the card (Monstrous Form [DOM][PRO], Masai Blood Milk), one given to other minions (Mark of Damnation, Vendetta: those in combat with the host), a card put in play and not on a minion (Brujah Debate, Esprit de Corps, Gangrel Revel, Week of Nightmares; Alvusia and In Memory of the Two Lands by their counters) and a card that becomes a minion (Abomination). employAnimal -- the play employs an ANIMAL retainer from the hand ignoring its requirements, its cost paid as normal (Biothaumaturgic Experiment [tha] alone). Not this key (F4): an employ from the hand with requirements and cost as normal (Pack Alpha [ani], Nosferatu Bestial, Piper, Jack of Both Sides: the plain employ’s), a card that moves or puts a retainer ignoring requirements AND cost (Compel the Spirit [NEC], Darius Styx: another key’s) and animal retainers moved from the ash heap (Summon Spirit Beast). maneuverTo -- a maneuver printed ‘only usable to go / get to long / close range’ (its one direction); the compiler’s since v1.11.3 (F1), on every card that prints it with a maneuver the compiler reads. plusIf -- a printed bonus with an additional amount when a condition holds (‘with an additional +1 bleed if this vampire is Toreador’; 25 Nov 2026, the exactness round, bot v0.6.241, the sweep register 7.1 and 7.2; each listed card read in KRCG’s text): Aire of Elation (this vampire Toreador), The Warrens (this Nosferatu titled), Protection Racket (the acting minion titled), Ministry (the acting vampire Sabbat), Sense the Sin [dai] (the acting minion with corruption counters), The Mausoleum, Venice (+1 vote; Ventrue Headquarters not in play). The bot reads two conditions, selfClan and selfTitled, on bleed and intercept; any other condition fails closed (no bonus). Not this key: an additional amount bought by a cost (Bowl of Convergence [AUS]: interceptPaid) or printed for the superior level (Soul Feasting [NEC]).
